audit.why: Aatrox bullies a farming Master Yi through level 5, evens at 6, and loses from first item — consistent with 50.74% over 406 games.
audit.corrected: Kept; the mechanics that make each stage true were added.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 stage was called "an even coinflip" with no numbers on either ultimate.
audit.why: Highlander is a flat 85s and World Ender is 120/100/80s — comparable, which is exactly why the stage is even. Stating 85s tells you how long the window lasts if he uses it and gets nothing.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and mid now give the 85s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The advice leaned on a World Ender "revive" that no longer exists, and never mentioned Meditate at all.
audit.why: World Ender's current text is minion fear plus AD, increased healing and Move Speed — no revive. Meanwhile Meditate (W, 10s) is a channel that heals him and reduces damage taken, and it pauses the remaining duration on Wuju Style and Highlander; interrupting it with your Q3 knockup denies the heal and the pause both.
audit.corrected: late no longer claims a revive; early now names Meditate as an interruptible channel.

edits.before: The 1v1 belongs to him now — Highlander resets and true damage cut straight through your sustain. Don't sidelane into him without a massive lead. Group instead: chained knockups, W drags and the World Ender revive turn you into the frontline that lets your team burst him before his resets snowball.
edits.after: The 1v1 belongs to him now — Highlander resets and Wuju Style true damage cut straight through your sustain. Don't sidelane into him without a massive lead. Group instead: chained knockups, W drags and World Ender's heal amp turn you into the frontline that lets your team burst him before his resets snowball.

edits.before: World Ender against Highlander is an even coinflip. Commit only at full HP with your R up.
edits.after: World Ender against Highlander is an even coinflip — Highlander is 85s. Commit at full HP.

edits.before: At 6 World Ender against Highlander is an even coinflip — commit only at full HP with R up. The moment his first item finishes, Wuju true damage starts outpacing your healing: stop face-tanking, hold W and your knockups to break his run-down, and spend your lead on plates and towers rather than coin-flip duels.
edits.after: At 6 World Ender against Highlander is an even coinflip — commit only at full HP with R up; Highlander is just 85s. The moment his first item finishes, Wuju Style true damage outpaces your healing: stop face-tanking, hold W and knockups to break his run-down, and spend your lead on plates.

edits.before: W and knockups on his run-down
edits.after: W and knockups break the run-down

edits.before: You are the lane bully and this phase decides the game. Your Q outranges and out-damages everything he has at 1-2, and by 3 the W plus full Q rotation gives him no safe way to CS. Chunk him every wave, deny farm, and bank a real lead before 6 — this matchup flips hard later.
edits.after: You are the lane bully and this phase decides the game. Your Q outranges and out-damages everything he has at 1-2, and by 3 the W plus full Q rotation gives him no safe CS. Meditate is his only sustain and it's a channel — knock him out of it. Deny farm and bank a real lead before 6.

notes: World Ender (R) has no revive in Riot's current text — it fears nearby minions and grants AD, increased healing and Move Speed, extended on a takedown. Any "revive" wording is stale and was corrected here; other champions' pages may still carry it. Alpha Strike (Q, 20s) also makes him untargetable for its duration — worth knowing before dumping a rotation, though it is not stated on the page (space). Aatrox's Infernal Chains (W) carries a derived "grounding" flag that Riot's description does not support (drag + slow only), so no grounding claim was made in this slice.
